positive_snippets: I had a comfortable stay at this hotel. The rooms were clean, well-maintained, and equipped with all basic amenities. The staff was polite, cooperative, and always ready to help, which made the stay pleasant. The location is convenient, with easy access to nearby metro station and transport. Food quality was good.Overall, it’s a good value-for-money hotel and I would recommend it for both business and short personal stays

Amazing experience. Really good stay and food as well. Excellent service.
negative_snippets:
I do not recommend staying at this hotel.
The hotel is very old and poorly maintained. The towels are extremely worn out, with threads coming out from the edges. Water leaks in from the outside through the window. The bed cover/duvet cover is torn, and the bed is uncomfortable. There are many other issues that clearly show a lack of maintenance and care.
